name: mashvisor/us-neighborhoods-boundaries
what_it_holds: GeoJSON/CSV neighborhood-boundary shapefiles derived from Zillow's discontinued Neighborhood Boundaries dataset, covering 42 US states; committed conversion output, CC0 licence.
why_useful: Not rental-performance data, but a committed, ready-to-use neighborhood-boundary geodataset (42 states) useful for joining any city-level STR/ADR series to consistent neighborhood polygons -- infrastructure for gap #2/#13 style work, not itself a KPI series.
themes: AirDNA / Mashvisor / AllTheRooms / Transparent / Key Data / Rabbu / Awning sample exports or scraped market pages committed to GitHub
Geocoding, neighbourhood boundaries and census-tract crosswalks used for STR studies; city GIS portals with STR layers
why_all: Not rental-performance data, but a committed, ready-to-use neighborhood-boundary geodataset (42 states) useful for joining any city-level STR/ADR series to consistent neighborhood polygons -- infrastructure for gap #2/#13 style work, not itself a KPI series.

US neighbourhood polygons are the join layer needed to aggregate Inside Airbnb listing lat/lon or STR registry addresses up to a consistent geography for cross-city comparison; Zillow's original file is no longer distributed so this mirror has standalone value.

name: OvertureMaps/schema
what_it_holds: Schema definitions (CC-BY-4.0, 212 stars, 1,595 commits) for all Overture themes including the `theme-places` package, which defines the category taxonomy used to classify POIs (would include accommodation/lodging/tourism categories, though exact list not extracted from this fetch — see docs.overturemaps.org for the full category tree).
why_useful: Needed alongside OvertureMaps/data to write a correct category filter for hotel/lodging extraction; not standalone data but the map key that makes the pull usable.
themes: Hotel supply data: Overture/OSM hotel POI counts, hotel pipeline datasets, lodging census (Census QSS NAICS 721), county business patterns tooling
POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Needed alongside OvertureMaps/data to write a correct category filter for hotel/lodging extraction; not standalone data but the map key that makes the pull usable.

Needed to write a category filter (e.g. 'lodging', 'hotel', 'bed_and_breakfast') against overturemaps-py pulls; without the schema, category-based hotel counting from Overture isn't reproducible.

name: OvertureMaps/stac
what_it_holds: Generates STAC (SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog) manifest files cataloguing every dated Overture Maps release, giving a machine-readable index of release dates back to the dataset's start.
why_useful: Gives the exact list of release timestamps needed to build a point-in-time hotel-POI-count time series (one count per release date) rather than only the latest snapshot — relevant to the point-in-time rule this project enforces.
